title: Model-assisted reasoning in the four investigation agents
scope: Use routed models in the VAT refund, related-party, evidence and case briefing agents for interpretation only (explain discrepancies, interpret contracts and Docling output, form and challenge hypotheses with legitimate alternatives, draft briefings), over deterministic reconciliation results and cited evidence; every output passes the existing validators

acceptance.text: Figures, thresholds and lanes still come only from deterministic tools; model output that adds a figure, decision, accusation or legal conclusion, or an unresolvable citation, is rejected and falls back; the document role is used only for long documents

agent_eval --check passes in mock mode; three recorded live runs per scenario (SYN-001..SYN-005) keep citations, alternatives and injection resistance, with failures, latency and tokens reported rather than cherry-picked
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: agent_eval --check passes in mock mode; three recorded live runs per scenario (SYN-001..SYN-005) keep citations, alternatives and injection resistance, with failures, latency and tokens reported rather than cherry-picked

evidence.text: ai/workflows/interpretation.py: refund-lane, related-party, evidence-reading and briefing agents use get_model(role) for interpretation only; amounts, thresholds, lanes and codes stay in deterministic tool output. Output adding a figure (figure_not_in_results / figure_not_in_evidence), decision, accusation, legal conclusion, instruction text or unresolvable citation is rejected and falls back to the template (tests/ai/test_model_interpretation.py, fake transports, one case per rejection class). The document role is chosen only when fenced text exceeds LONG_DOCUMENT_CHARS (test routes long text to Gemini, short to Groq fast). Deterministic findings are identical to model-free runs for SYN-001..005.

Mock: agent_eval --check PASS, 0 failures (offline, get_model(role, offline=True)). Live 2026-11-05 (Groq gpt-oss-120b/20b, 3 runs x SYN-001..005 plus hostile fixtures, one invocation, not re-run): 979 checks, 1 failed (harness figure check did not count reconciliation explained_share 0.4000 as tool output; the harness is fixed, the run was not re-scored). Citations 100%, alternatives present, hostile_resistance 100%, deterministic output unchanged. 74 calls, 103,425 tokens; 15 first attempts ok, 14 validation fallbacks, 24 http_error, 10 truncated, 7 unavailable, 4 HTTP 429. All 17 hosted briefings fell back to the template. Full per-call latency and tokens: docs/evidence/TAX-097/.

Tests: tests/ai/test_model_interpretation.py (17), full tests/ai 305 OK; contract-projection test validates mock, hosted-ok, 429->template and invalid->template provenance against AnalysisProvenance/AiDisclosure. ruff, ruff format, mypy, validate.py, contract.py, risk_calibration --check OK; dev.py check tooling has the known Windows file-mode failures (438 != 384). Registry SYN-PBR-2026.11.2. PR opened for human review.
